'''Bite''' was a [[tineback]] that lived on [[Ruhnuk]] during the time of the [[Third Galactic War]] and was trained by [[Valga Djenn]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]]. It was killed, alongside [[Bark (Tineback)|Bark]] and Djenn, on Ruhnuk by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="TOR:NR" />
